title: Bicycle with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- back wheel -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='68' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#38e8b0' stroke-width='5'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='68' r='5' fill='#ff8c1a'/>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='68' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#38e8b0' stroke-width='5'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='68' r='5' fill='#ff8c1a'/>
  <!-- spokes back -->
  <line x1='24' y1='52' x2='24' y2='84' stroke='#7cf5d5' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='8' y1='68' x2='40' y2='68' stroke='#7cf5d5' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- spokes front -->
  <line x1='76' y1='52' x2='76' y2='84' stroke='#7cf5d5' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='68' x2='92' y2='68' stroke='#7cf5d5' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- frame -->
  <line x1='24' y1='68' x2='42' y2='42' stroke='#ff4d6d' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='42' x2='62' y2='68' stroke='#ff4d6d' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='68' x2='24' y2='68' stroke='#ff4d6d' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='42' x2='76' y2='68' stroke='#ff4d6d' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='68' x2='42' y2='42' stroke='#ffb3c1' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- seat post and seat -->
  <line x1='42' y1='42' x2='38' y2='30' stroke='#ffcc33' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <rect x='30' y='26' width='16' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <!-- handlebars -->
  <line x1='76' y1='68' x2='70' y2='38' stroke='#ffcc33' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='36' x2='78' y2='36' stroke='#ffd966' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- pedal -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='68' r='5' fill='#c084fc'/>
  <!-- smiling face on the frame -->
  <!-- face circle -->
  <circle cx='51' cy='55' r='9' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='53' r='1.6' fill='#5b2a86'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='53' r='1.6' fill='#5b2a86'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M47 57 Q51 61 55 57' fill='none' stroke='#5b2a86' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little cheeks -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='56' r='1.2' fill='#ff7aa2'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='56' r='1.2' fill='#ff7aa2'/>
  <!-- tiny bell -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='32' r='3.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#ff9f1c'/>
</svg>
